description: Binance spot last price for one trading pair (for example BTCUSDT), from Binance's public ticker endpoint. Only the last price is returned; no order book or history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_binance_orderbook_depth when you need Binance spot order book snapshot for one pair: best bid. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
